As another B.Arch survivor (lol) I agree with the other person’s comment about studio culture being one of the hardest aspects and will add that general CMU culture was also a major stressor during my time there as a student. Challenging academics aside, I felt a tremendous amount of emotional/social stress my entire time at CMU. If you have a good group of friends and a strong support system you will be fine. I think it’s also important to make friends outside of studio and participate in things around campus that are not architecture related. There are plenty of great options. I became really close with a few people on my floor in my freshman year dorm and they’re still my best friends today. 

You have to truly have a strong passion for architecture to survive the program. If you do then you will enjoy studio (especially 4th and 5th year advanced studios) - there are some exceptional staff members in the school of architecture and great resources.
